overview_description.description:
uTrack TV is a video on demand application and platform for live streaming events. The platform provides unique content from across the world specializing in motorsports, sports & entertainment offering both live events and championships as well as documentaries, biographies, and much more both original by uTrack and content produced by others. They specialize in Live broadcast of any event through their Mobile App technology which is compatible with any connected device.

uTrack TV bridges the gap between fans and events, creating a higher market value to championships by attracting sponsorship and viewership for a mutual benefit of all entities. The platform live stream the event through their unique transcoding technology to a worldwide audience of their Free app on both Android and iOS.
